lines.en: I crawl slowly, faintly glowing.
My shell shines in the dark.
I cross moss and it gleams.
I crawl deeper into the cave.
My light sweeps the stalactites.
I leave a line of light on the ground.
I crawl around a stalagmite.
I climb a short way up.
I crawl out of the water.
I move along the cave wall.
I sway my head, testing the way.
I head for the brighter moss.
I drag myself through a stone gap.
I come a little closer to you.
I lie on the moss, glowing.
My light swells and dims.
My segments draw in.
I shine quietly in the cave.
My body swells once.
I wait for a small bug to come.
I pull my head into my body.
I slowly curl up.
My light sways on a stalactite.

lines.zh: 我不动，像一节会亮的小灯。
lines.en: I stay still, a little glowing lamp.
My feelers rest on the stone.
Now and then I flash.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，光打在你脸上。
lines.en: I raise my head and my light hits your face.
I crawl a little your way.
My light reflects on your boot tip.
I sway my head at you.
You are blocking my moss.
I slowly turn my body to you.

lines.zh: 我的身体亮得更明显了。
lines.en: My body glows brighter.
I sniff your approach.
I stop half a block away.
My light dips, then returns.
My light goes out for an instant.
I curl into one small segment.
I let out not one sound.
A mark shows on my shell.
I crawl away a little.
I curl into a ring.
The glow-shell's light flickered.
I dare not glow that long again.
I crawl toward that thing.
I circle it first.
My light reveals it plainly.
I take one bite.
I push it onto the moss.
I am not sure it is edible.
I eat it little by little.
I look up at you again.
This iron goes back to my rock crevice.
I push it aside.
You step on me and my light wavers.
I am knocked half a block.
My light sweeps over you.
You kick me aside a little.
We make a small sound.
I quickly climb a stone.
My light briefly goes out.
My shell is heavy, so I shift slowly.
Two little lights draw together.
Our lights join.
They circle each other slowly.

lines.zh: 它们的光一明一暗地对着。
lines.en: Their lights pulse in turn.
We climb onto the moss together.
Their heads rest together.

lines.zh: 我们的光混成一种颜色。
lines.en: Our lights blend into one color.
We slip into a stone crack together.

lines.zh: 它们彼此不发一点声音。
lines.en: They make no sound to each other.
We crawl toward the dark together.

lines.zh: 我叼起那粒发亮的东西。
lines.en: I take the glowing speck.
A scrap of iron sits just right on my shell.
I coil around it and crawl.
It is brighter than the moss.
Tucked in the crack, I'll haul it later.
I try to swallow it.
I push it with my feelers.
It presses against my segments.
My light settles on you.

lines.zh: 我闻到了不一样的味道。
lines.en: I smell something different.
I begin crawling that way.
My body brightens a step.
I lower my head and push forward.
I have picked the one by your feet.
All my feelers point forward.

lines.zh: 这里只有你一个是新的。
lines.en: You are the only new thing here.
My light leans that way.
I pause to confirm the spot.
I brighten again and again.

lines.zh: 我把身体从苔藓上挪开。
lines.en: I shift my body off the moss.
I follow you along the cracks.
Your steps make the moss sway.
I keep glowing your way.
I close in bit by bit.
You are at the mouth; I am inside.
I come around the stalactite after you.
I am not fast, but my light is obvious.

lines.zh: 我停在你看不见的凹处。
lines.en: I stop in a hollow you cannot see.
You are in the water; I hug its edge.

lines.zh: 我的光顺着你的路过去。
lines.en: My light travels along your path.
I am only two blocks from you.
I keep glowing at your feet.
I butt my head into your ankle.

lines.zh: 我咬住裤脚，铁锈味真香。
lines.en: I clamp your cuff; the rust taste is sweet.

lines.zh: 我的光照得你睁不开眼。
lines.en: My light makes you squint.

lines.zh: 我把你脚边的苔藓压扁。
lines.en: I crush the moss at your feet.
I coil around your toe.
My hit makes you step back.
I bite and crawl away.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里窜出来撞你。
lines.en: I dart out of a crack and hit you.
My light sways in front of your eyes.
A small light appears in the dark.
I crawl out onto the moss.
A patch of the wall lights up.

lines.zh: 这里多了一节会亮的东西。
lines.en: Something glowing has appeared here.
My light reveals the stone first.
You hear a faint scraping.
I begin to glow in the cave.

lines.zh: 一个小小的光点移动了。
lines.en: A small point of light moves.
I glow and crawl slowly.
Fire drowns out my light.

lines.zh: 我从钟乳石上掉下来，摔在石头上。
lines.en: I fall from a stalactite onto stone.

lines.zh: 水没过我，光在水里散开。
lines.en: Water covers me and my light spreads in it.
The blast is far brighter than me.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过我一节身子。
lines.en: An arrow passes through one segment of me.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的光掐灭了。
lines.en: That force snuffs out my light.
Hunger dims my glow.

lines.zh: 雷光在洞里炸开，我全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning bursts in the cave and I flare up.

lines.zh: 下面的石头没了，我掉下去。
lines.en: The stone below is gone; I fall.
